title: 第十九章 枪声第二十章 所以只能打死他们
content_zh:
走出体育馆。
许杰三人异常激动，半路上嘴都没停过。
“强！
实在太强了！”
“王腾哥，高级武徒都这么强吗？”
“对普通人而言，高级武徒是挺强的。”
王腾点了根烟，深吸一口，缓缓吐出，淡然的说道。
“哈哈，太好了，以后有你罩着，就没人敢欺负我们了。”
许杰大笑道。
“王腾哥，你说我以后也能像你一样强吗？”
余浩暗暗捏紧拳头，羡慕的问道。
“好好练，高级武徒并非难事。”
王腾说道。
白薇在一旁没有说话，只是她的目光总会时不时的落在王腾身上，嘴角浮现一丝甜甜的笑意。
四人在学校门口分别，各自回家找妈妈。
回家路上，王腾一直在想，为什么李荣成那么弱？
这不是装逼，是他真的觉得李荣成太弱！
当他开车行驶在路上，看到旁边疾驰而过的车辆时，他突然就恍然大悟了。
速度！
没错，就是速度！

天下武功，唯快不破！
他的速度超过李荣成太多，因此李荣成的攻击在他看来，实在太慢。
慢到他只用了两招，就将李荣成击昏在地。
属性面板上的速度属性并不是很直观，王腾一直捡属性提升，却压根没试过到底有多快。
今天突然爆发，结果李荣成毫无还手之力！
晚上，王腾回家吃完了饭，就前往极星武馆训练，捡属性提升自我。
而接下来几天，他的生活也没什么波澜。
白天听课，捡属性提升文化课知识，偶尔还会调戏下冷冰冰的美同桌，生活过的美滋滋。
而且几天下来，他的文化课提升很快，现在直接考试，他都有把握考上九十分。
这个程度完全够了，他又不打算考什么文科状元！
再说与之前比起来，不要好太多。
晚上他雷打不动的去极星武馆签到训练，并捡属性提升武道修为。
如今他的各项武道属性早就破了高级武徒的极限。
【悟性】：51
【体质】：121
【力量】：1356
【速度】：632
content_en:
Walk out of the gym.
Xu Jie and the other three were extremely excited and didn't stop talking during the whole process.
"Strong!
It's too strong! "
"Brother Wang Teng, are all high-level martial arts disciples so strong?"
"For ordinary people, high-level warriors are quite strong."
Wang Teng lit a cigarette, took a deep breath, exhaled slowly, and said calmly.
"Haha, great. With you protecting me from now on, no one will dare to bully us."
Xu Jie laughed.
"Brother Wang Teng, do you think I can be as strong as you in the future?"
Yu Hao secretly clenched his fists and asked enviously.
"Practice hard, it's not difficult to become a high-level martial artist."
Wang Teng said.
Bai Wei didn't speak at the side, but her eyes would always fall on Wang Teng from time to time, and a sweet smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
The four of them separated at the school gate and went home to find their mother.
On the way home, Wang Teng kept thinking, why is Li Rongcheng so weak?
This is not pretentious, but he really thinks Li Rongcheng is too weak!
When he was driving on the road and saw the cars passing by, he suddenly understood.
speed!
That's right, it's speed!
In the world of martial arts, only speed is unbeatable!
His speed was much faster than Li Rongcheng's, so Li Rongcheng's attack was too slow in his opinion.
It was so slow that he only used two moves to knock Li Rongcheng unconscious to the ground.
The speed attribute on the attribute panel is not very intuitive. Wang Teng keeps looking for attribute improvements, but has never tried how fast it is.
It suddenly broke out today, and Li Rongcheng was unable to fight back!
In the evening, Wang Teng went home and finished his meal, then went to Ji Xing Martial Arts Hall to train and pick up attributes to improve himself.
In the next few days, his life was uneventful.
During the day, I listened to classes, picked up attributes to improve my cultural knowledge, and occasionally flirted with my cold and beautiful classmate, living a happy life.
Moreover, after a few days, his cultural class improved rapidly. Now he is sure to get 90% in the exam directly.
This level is completely enough, and he doesn't plan to take the first prize in liberal arts!
Besides, it's not much better than before.
In the evening, he went to Ji Xing Martial Arts Hall to sign up for training and picked up attributes to improve his martial arts skills.
Now his various martial arts attributes have already exceeded the limits of high-level martial arts.
